<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Ramen</title>
<style>
  * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
  html, body { width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; background:#070504; }
  body { position:fixed; inset:0; }
  canvas { display:block; width:100vw; height:100vh; width:100dvw; height:100dvh; cursor:crosshair; touch-action:none; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    canvas { cursor:default; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const REDUCED = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
  let cx = 0, cy = 0, S = 0; // center + scale unit

  // Mouse state (smoothed)
  const mouse = { x: 0, y: 0, tx: 0, ty: 0, px: 0, py: 0, active: false, down: 0, tdown: 0 };
  let wind = 0, windT = 0;

  // Ripples on the broth
  const ripples = [];
  let lastRippleAt = 0;

  // Steam particles
  const steam = [];
  const STEAM_N = REDUCED ? 0 : 90;
  // Ambient dust motes
  const motes = [];

  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }

  function resize() {
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
    canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
    cx = W / 2; cy = H / 2;
    S = Math.min(W, H);
    if (REDUCED) drawStatic();
  }

  function initParticles() {
    steam.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < STEAM_N; i++) {
      steam.push({
        x: rand(-0.32, 0.32),       // relative to bowl width
        y: Math.random(),           // life 0..1
        speed: rand(0.045, 0.11),
        size: rand(0.06, 0.20),
        phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
        sway: rand(0.6, 1.4),
        alpha: rand(0.10, 0.32),
        seed: Math.random() * 1000
      });
    }
    motes.length = 0;
    const n = Math.round(Math.min(46, Math.max(18, S / 18)));
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      motes.push({
        x: Math.random(), y: Math.random(),
        r: rand(0.6, 2.1),
        vx: rand(-0.006, 0.006), vy: rand(-0.010, -0.003),
        phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2), a: rand(0.08, 0.35)
      });
    }
  }

  // ---------- helpers ----------
  function ellipse(x, y, rx, ry) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  }
  function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }

  // ---------- background ----------
  function drawBackground(t, mx, my) {
    // Deep, warm near-black
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx + mx * 30, cy - S * 0.18 + my * 20, S * 0.05, cx, cy, S * 0.95);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#1c1108');
    g.addColorStop(0.35, '#120b06');
    g.addColorStop(0.65, '#0a0605');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#050303');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Ambient warmth behind the bowl — breathes slowly, follows the pointer a little
    const flicker = REDUCED ? 1 : 1 + Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.035 + Math.sin(t * 1.7 + 1.3) * 0.02;
    const gx = cx + mx * S * 0.06;
    const gy = cy - S * 0.10 + my * S * 0.03;
    const gr = S * 0.62 * flicker;
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(gx, gy, 0, gx, gy, gr);
    glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,166,66,0.20)');
    glow.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(232,119,38,0.12)');
    glow.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(160,72,20,0.05)');
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.fillRect(gx - gr, gy - gr, gr * 2, gr * 2);

    // Table surface — a soft horizontal pool of light under the bowl
    const tableY = cy + S * 0.235;
    const tg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, tableY, 0, cx, tableY, S * 0.52);
    tg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,170,80,0.10)');
    tg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(120,64,24,0.05)');
    tg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, tableY); ctx.scale(1, 0.32); ctx.translate(-cx, -tableY);
    ctx.fillStyle = tg;
    ellipse(cx, tableY, S * 0.52, S * 0.52); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // Floating dust motes in the warm light
    if (!REDUCED) {
      for (const m of motes) {
        const px = m.x * W + Math.sin(t * 0.3 + m.phase) * 10 + mx * 8;
        const py = m.y * H + Math.cos(t * 0.22 + m.phase) * 8;
        const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 0.9 + m.phase * 3);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(px, py, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,205,140,${(m.a * tw).toFixed(3)})`;
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawVignetteAndGrain(t) {
    const v = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, S * 0.32, cx, cy, S * 0.92);
    v.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    v.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.28)');
    v.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.72)');
    ctx.fillStyle = v;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // Fine grain — sparse, deterministic jitter so it never feels digital-flat
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.05;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdfb0';
    const step = Math.max(52, S / 14);
    const off = REDUCED ? 0 : (t * 7) % step;
    for (let x = -step; x < W + step; x += step) {
      for (let y = -step; y < H + step; y += step) {
        const n = Math.sin(x * 12.9898 + y * 78.233) * 43758.5453;
        const f = n - Math.floor(n);
        if (f > 0.72) ctx.fillRect(x + f * 20 + off * 0.1, y + f * 14, 1.1, 1.1);
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- bowl ----------
  function drawBowl(t, mx, my) {
    const bw = S * 0.62;                 // bowl rim width
    const bh = S * 0.30;                 // bowl body depth
    const rimY = cy + S * 0.015 + my * S * 0.006;
    const rimRX = bw / 2, rimRY = bw * 0.185;
    const footY = rimY + bh;
    const tilt = mx * 0.018;

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx + mx * S * 0.012, cy + my * S * 0.008);
    ctx.rotate(tilt);
    ctx.translate(-cx, -cy);

    // Ground shadow
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
    ellipse(cx, footY + S * 0.028, rimRX * 0.92, rimRY * 0.85); ctx.fill();
    ctx.filter = 'blur(14px)';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)';
    ellipse(cx, footY + S * 0.02, rimRX * 0.78, rimRY * 0.6); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // Bowl body — dark stoneware with a warm under-light
    const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - rimRX, rimY, cx + rimRX, footY);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#17120e');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#241a12');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.52, '#2e2115');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.78, '#1a120c');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0d0906');

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - rimRX, rimY);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - rimRX * 0.98, rimY + bh * 0.42, cx - rimRX * 0.62, rimY + bh * 0.82, cx - rimRX * 0.30, footY - bh * 0.10);
    ctx.lineTo(cx - rimRX * 0.22, footY);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + rimRX * 0.22, footY);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + rimRX * 0.30, footY - bh * 0.10);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + rimRX * 0.62, rimY + bh * 0.82, cx + rimRX * 0.98, rimY + bh * 0.42, cx + rimRX, rimY);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    ctx.fill();

    // Foot ring
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0705';
    ctx.fillRect(cx - rimRX * 0.23, footY - 1, rimRX * 0.46, S * 0.012 + 2);
    ellipse(cx, footY + S * 0.010, rimRX * 0.23, rimRY * 0.16);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#080605'; ctx.fill();

    // Warm bounce on the lower bowl + specular sweep following the pointer
    const bounce = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx + mx * rimRX * 0.4, footY - bh * 0.18, 0, cx, footY - bh * 0.2, rimRX * 1.05);
    bounce.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,150,60,0.14)');
    bounce.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(255,130,50,0.05)');
    bounce.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.save();
    ctx.clip(); // still inside body path? re-clip with same path approximation via body region
    ctx.restore();
    // (drawn as overlay ellipse, clipped by bowl silhouette using composite)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - rimRX, rimY);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - rimRX * 0.98, rimY + bh * 0.42, cx - rimRX * 0.62, rimY + bh * 0.82, cx - rimRX * 0.30, footY - bh * 0.10);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + rimRX * 0.30, footY - bh * 0.10);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + rimRX * 0.62, rimY + bh * 0.82, cx + rimRX * 0.98, rimY + bh * 0.42, cx + rimRX, rimY);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.clip();
    ctx.fillStyle = bounce;
    ctx.fillRect(cx - rimRX, rimY, bw, bh + 4);
    // Left rim light / right falloff
    const rimLight = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - rimRX, 0, cx + rimRX, 0);
    rimLight.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,190,110,0.16)');
    rimLight.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(255,190,110,0.03)');
    rimLight.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.10)');
    rimLight.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.28)');
    ctx.fillStyle = rimLight;
    ctx.fillRect(cx - rimRX, rimY, bw, bh);
    // Speckled glaze
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,170,0.10)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
      const a = (Math.sin(i * 47.3) * 0.5 + 0.5) * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;
      const px = cx + Math.cos(a + 1.2) * rimRX * (0.35 + (i % 7) * 0.09);
      const py = rimY + bh * (0.25 + ((i * 13) % 60) / 100);
      if (px > cx - rimRX && px < cx + rimRX) ctx.fillRect(px, py, 1.2, 1.2);
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // ---- Interior: broth, clipped to the rim ellipse ----
    ctx.save();
    ellipse(cx, rimY, rimRX, rimRY);
    ctx.clip();

    // Broth base
    const broth = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - rimRX * 0.2, rimY - rimRY * 0.3, rimRX * 0.1, cx, rimY, rimRX * 1.05);
    broth.addColorStop(0, '#e8a34a');
    broth.addColorStop(0.35, '#d98a33');
    broth.addColorStop(0.62, '#b96d22');
    broth.addColorStop(0.85, '#8a4d18');
    broth.addColorStop(1, '#6e3c12');
    ctx.fillStyle = broth;
    ctx.fillRect(cx - rimRX, rimY - rimRY, bw, rimRY * 2);

    // Slow swirling currents in the broth
    const swirl = REDUCED ? 0 : t * 0.14;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.16;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffd489';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, S * 0.0035);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      const rr = rimRX * (0.30 + i * 0.16);
      ctx.ellipse(cx, rimY, rr, rr * (rimRY / rimRX), swirl + i * 0.7, swirl + i, swirl + i + 1.5);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // Chili oil — glossy amber droplets that drift almost imperceptibly
    const drift = REDUCED ? 0 : t * 0.05;
    for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
      const ang = i * 2.39996 + drift * (0.4 + (i % 3) * 0.2); // golden-angle spread
      const rad = Math.sqrt((i + 0.5) / 22) * 0.86;
      const ox = Math.cos(ang) * rimRX * rad;
      const oy = Math.sin(ang) * rimRY * rad * 0.92;
      const r = (2.2 + (i % 5) * 1.1) * (S / 700 + 0.55);
      const og = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx + ox - r * 0.3, rimY + oy - r * 0.3, 0, cx + ox, rimY + oy, r);
      og.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,196,86,0.95)');
      og.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(214,92,26,0.85)');
      og.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(150,52,12,0.0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = og;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + ox, rimY + oy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }

    // Broth surface light — a soft sheen that leans toward the pointer
    const sheen = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx + mx * rimRX * 0.5, rimY - rimRY * 0.45, 0, cx + mx * rimRX * 0.5, rimY, rimRX * 0.9);
    sheen.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,226,160,0.20)');
    sheen.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,200,110,0.06)');
    sheen.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sheen;
    ctx.fillRect(cx - rimRX, rimY - rimRY, bw, rimRY * 2);

    // Ripples from pointer movement / taps
    for (const r of ripples) {
      const p = r.age / r.life;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(r.x, r.y, r.r * p * 2.4, r.r * p * 2.4 * (rimRY / rimRX), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,225,170,${(0.35 * (1 - p)).toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.4 * (1 - p) + 0.4;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(r.x, r.y, r.r * p * 1.4, r.r * p * 1.4 * (rimRY / rimRX), 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,210,140,${(0.22 * (1 - p)).toFixed(3)})`;
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // ===== Toppings (all vegan) =====
    const bob = REDUCED ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 1.15) * S * 0.0016;

    // Noodle nest — layered wavy strands under everything
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    for (let layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++) {
      const ly = rimY - rimRY * 0.08 + layer * rimRY * 0.16 + bob * (layer * 0.4);
      for (let i = 0; i < 7 - layer; i++) {
        const yy = ly + (i - 3) * rimRY * 0.10;
        const amp = rimRY * (0.10 + (i % 3) * 0.03);
        const ph = i * 1.7 + layer * 2.1 + (REDUCED ? 0 : t * 0.35);
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let x = -rimRX * 0.72; x <= rimRX * 0.72; x += 8) {
          const y = yy + Math.sin(x * 0.028 + ph) * amp * Math.cos(x / rimRX * 1.2);
          const px = cx + x * (1 - layer * 0.10);
          if (x === -rimRX * 0.72) ctx.moveTo(px, y); else ctx.lineTo(px, y);
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = layer === 0 ? '#f2d492' : (layer === 1 ? '#e9c67e' : '#dcb26a');
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.6, S * 0.0042 - layer * 0.6);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95 - layer * 0.12;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Nori sheets — two dark sheets leaning at the back rim
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx - rimRX * 0.52, rimY - rimRY * 0.52 + bob);
    ctx.rotate(-0.16 + (REDUCED ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.6) * 0.012));
    ctx.fillStyle = '#101a12';
    ctx.fillRect(-rimRX * 0.20, -rimRY * 1.05, rimRX * 0.34, rimRY * 1.15);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(70,110,62,0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(-rimRX * 0.20, -rimRY * 1.05, rimRX * 0.34, 3);
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx - rimRX * 0.36, rimY - rimRY * 0.46 + bob);
    ctx.rotate(-0.05);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0c140d';
    ctx.fillRect(-rimRX * 0.18, -rimRY * 0.92, rimRX * 0.30, rimRY * 1.02);
    ctx.restore();

    // Bok choy — bright leaves on the right
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const lx = cx + rimRX * (0.38 + i * 0.11);
      const ly = rimY - rimRY * (0.18 - i * 0.10) + bob + i * 2;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(lx, ly);
      ctx.rotate(0.5 + i * 0.38 + (REDUCED ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.8 + i) * 0.02));
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(rimRX * 0.10, -rimRY * 0.42, rimRX * 0.20, -rimRY * 0.30, rimRX * 0.13, rimRY * 0.05);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(rimRX * 0.06, rimRY * 0.22, -rimRX * 0.05, rimRY * 0.18, 0, 0);
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 ? '#3f7d2e' : '#4c9136';
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(rimRX * 0.07, -rimRY * 0.18, rimRX * 0.12, -rimRY * 0.28);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(210,240,170,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Shiitake mushrooms — sliced caps, left-center
    const shrooms = [[-0.30, -0.28], [-0.13, -0.42], [-0.42, -0.02]];
    for (let i = 0; i < shrooms.length; i++) {
      const sx = cx + rimRX * shrooms[i][0], sy = rimY + rimRY * shrooms[i][1] + bob;
      const sr = rimRX * 0.115;
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(sx, sy); ctx.rotate(-0.3 + i * 0.35);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, sr, sr * 0.62, 0, Math.PI, 0); ctx.closePath();
      const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -sr, 0, sr);
      sg.addColorStop(0, '#8a5a34'); sg.addColorStop(1, '#5d3a1e');
      ctx.fillStyle = sg; ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e8d9b8';
      ctx.fillRect(-sr * 0.16, 0, sr * 0.32, sr * 0.30);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,35,15,0.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let gLine = -2; gLine <= 2; gLine++) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gLine * sr * 0.10 - 2, 1); ctx.lineTo(gLine * sr * 0.10 + 2, sr * 0.26); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Tofu cubes — golden seared edges
    const tofu = [[0.08, -0.44], [0.24, -0.30], [-0.02, -0.18], [0.16, -0.06]];
    for (let i = 0; i < tofu.length; i++) {
      const tx = cx + rimRX * tofu[i][0], ty = rimY + rimRY * tofu[i][1] + bob * (1 + i * 0.15);
      const ts = rimRX * 0.075 * (S / 700 + 0.6);
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(tx, ty); ctx.rotate((i * 0.7 - 1) * 0.35);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f0e3c2';
      ctx.fillRect(-ts / 2, -ts / 2, ts, ts * 0.88);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#d99a3d';
      ctx.fillRect(-ts / 2, -ts / 2, ts, ts * 0.30);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,95,30,0.35)';
      ctx.fillRect(-ts / 2, ts * 0.28, ts, 1.2);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Sweetcorn kernels
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const ang = i * 2.7 + 0.6, rad = 0.28 + (i % 4) * 0.13;
      const kx = cx + Math.cos(ang) * rimRX * rad * 0.9;
      const ky = rimY + Math.sin(ang) * rimRY * rad + bob;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(kx, ky, S * 0.006 + 1.6, S * 0.0042 + 1.1, ang, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 3 ? '#f6c945' : '#eeb52e'; ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(kx - 1, ky - 1, 1.1, 0.7, ang, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,246,190,0.8)'; ctx.fill();
    }

    // Scallion rings — scattered, gently bobbing
    for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
      const ang = i * 2.39996 + 1.1;
      const rad = Math.sqrt((i + 0.5) / 26) * 0.88;
      const sx = cx + Math.cos(ang) * rimRX * rad;
      const sy = rimY + Math.sin(ang) * rimRY * rad * 0.9 + bob + (REDUCED ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 1.3 + i * 1.7) * 1.1);
      const r = (S * 0.0055 + 1.8) * (0.75 + (i % 3) * 0.22);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = i % 4 === 0 ? '#8fd45e' : '#5da83c';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.1, r * 0.52); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Chili threads + sesame
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(196,42,28,0.85)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.3; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const hx = cx + rimRX * (0.02 + (i % 3 - 1) * 0.09);
      const hy = rimY - rimRY * 0.28 + Math.floor(i / 3) * rimRY * 0.16 + bob;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(hx - 6, hy + (i % 2 ? 3 : -3));
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(hx, hy - 4, hx + 7, hy + 2); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,248,225,0.9)';
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      const ang = i * 2.39996 + 2.4, rad = Math.sqrt((i + 0.5) / 20) * 0.8;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(cx + Math.cos(ang) * rimRX * rad, rimY + Math.sin(ang) * rimRY * rad + bob);
      ctx.rotate(ang * 3);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 2.1, 1.05, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.restore(); // un-clip broth

    // Rim — ceramic lip with a warm catch-light that tracks the pointer
    ellipse(cx, rimY, rimRX, rimRY);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0b0806';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(5, S * 0.011);
    ctx.stroke();
    ellipse(cx, rimY, rimRX - 2, rimRY - 1);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,186,105,0.30)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.stroke();
    // Highlight arc on the rim (leans with mouse)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, rimY, rimRX - 1, rimRY - 1, 0, Math.PI * (1.08 + mx * 0.08), Math.PI * (1.62 + mx * 0.08));
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,214,150,0.55)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.stroke();
    // Inner shadow just inside the lip
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, rimY + 2, rimRX - 5, rimRY - 3, 0, Math.PI * 0.08, Math.PI * 0.92);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,18,4,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // ---- Lifted noodles + chopsticks ----
    drawLiftedNoodles(t, rimY, rimRX, rimRY, mx, my, bob);

    ctx.restore(); // parallax transform

    return { rimY, rimRX, rimRY, bw, footY };
  }

  function drawLiftedNoodles(t, rimY, rimRX, rimRY, mx, my, bob) {
    const lift = REDUCED ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.85) * S * 0.004;
    const sway = REDUCED ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.9 + 0.6) * S * 0.006 + mx * S * 0.010;
    const handX = cx + rimRX * 0.34 + mx * S * 0.008;
    const handY = rimY - S * 0.185 + lift + my * S * 0.006;
    const mouthX = cx + rimRX * 0.10, mouthY = rimY - rimRY * 0.10 + bob;

    // Hanging strands from chopsticks down into the broth
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    const strands = 6;
    for (let i = 0; i < strands; i++) {
      const off = (i - (strands - 1) / 2) * S * 0.0075;
      const sx = handX + off * 0.4, sy = handY + Math.abs(off) * 0.35;
      const ex = mouthX + off * 1.5 + sway * (0.4 + i * 0.1), ey = mouthY;
      const sag = S * (0.055 + (i % 3) * 0.010) + Math.abs(off) * 0.6;
      const wob = REDUCED ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 1.6 + i * 1.3) * S * 0.0035;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(
        sx + sway * 0.3 + wob, sy + sag * 0.55,
        ex - sway * 0.4 - wob, ey - sag * 0.45,
        ex, ey
      );
      ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 ? '#f4d794' : '#eccb82';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.7, S * 0.0042);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Strand highlight
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(sx + sway * 0.3, sy + sag * 0.5, ex - sway * 0.4, ey - sag * 0.5, ex, ey);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,244,205,0.45)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // The gathered bundle at the chopsticks
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(handX + (i - 1.5) * 2.2, handY + 3 + i * 1.1, S * 0.013 - i, S * 0.006, 0.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = i % 2 ? '#f0d18a' : '#e6c476';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.6, S * 0.0036);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // A couple of scallions clinging to the lifted noodles
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(handX - 6, handY + 10, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#6fbc45'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(handX + 9 + sway * 0.3, handY + 16, 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#8fd45e'; ctx.stroke();

    // Chopsticks — warm bamboo, angled up to the right, tips pinching the noodles
    const tipX = handX, tipY = handY;
    const endX = cx + rimRX * 0.98 + mx * S * 0.010, endY = rimY - S * 0.335 + lift * 0.6;
    const dx = endX - tipX, dy = endY - tipY;
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const nx = -dy / len, ny = dx / len; // perpendicular
    const gap = S * 0.0075;
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      const ox = nx * gap * s, oy = ny * gap * s;
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(tipX + ox, tipY + oy, endX + ox, endY + oy);
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#8a5a2e');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#c99a58');
      grad.addColorStop(1, '#a9763c');
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tipX + ox, tipY + oy);
      ctx.lineTo(endX + ox, endY + oy);
      ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, S * 0.0075);
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(tipX + ox, tipY + oy);
      ctx.lineTo(endX + ox, endY + oy);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,225,170,0.30)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // ---------- steam ----------
  function drawSteam(t, dt, geom) {
    if (REDUCED || !geom) return;
    const { rimY, rimRX, rimRY } = geom;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
    for (const p of steam) {
      p.y -= p.speed * dt;
      if (p.y < 0) { p.y = 1; p.x = rand(-0.32, 0.32); p.phase = rand(0, Math.PI * 2); }
      const life = p.y; // 1 = at broth, 0 = top
      const rise = (1 - life) * S * 0.46;
      const swayX = Math.sin(life * 5.2 + p.phase + t * 0.7) * S * 0.018 * p.sway
                  + Math.sin(t * 0.45 + p.seed) * S * 0.006;
      const windPush = wind * S * 0.09 * (1 - life);
      const px = cx + p.x * rimRX + swayX + windPush + mouse.x * S * 0.010 * (1 - life);
      const py = rimY - rimRY * 0.55 - rise + Math.sin(p.seed + t * 0.5) * 2;
      const r = (p.size * S * 0.16) * (0.55 + (1 - life) * 1.15);
      const fadeIn = Math.min(1, (1 - life) * 6 + 0.15);
      const fadeOut = Math.pow(life, 0.6);
      const a = p.alpha * fadeIn * fadeOut * 0.55;
      if (a <= 0.004 || r <= 1) continue;
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, r);
      g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,246,235,${a.toFixed(3)})`);
      g.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(255,238,220,${(a * 0.45).toFixed(3)})`);
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,240,225,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // Inner brighter core for a few particles gives the steam body
      if (p.size > 0.13) {
        const g2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(px - r * 0.15, py - r * 0.1, 0, px, py, r * 0.5);
        g2.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,252,246,${(a * 0.7).toFixed(3)})`);
        g2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,250,240,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = g2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawStaticSteam(geom) {
    if (!geom) return;
    const { rimY, rimRX } = geom;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const px = cx + (i / 13 - 0.5) * rimRX * 0.55 + Math.sin(i * 2.1) * 12;
      const py = rimY - S * (0.07 + (i % 5) * 0.028);
      const r = S * (0.035 + (i % 4) * 0.012);
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(px, py, 0, px, py, r);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,246,235,0.10)');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,240,225,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ---------- main draw ----------
  function draw(t, dt) {
    // Smooth the pointer for buttery parallax
    mouse.x = lerp(mouse.x, mouse.tx, 0.045);
    mouse.y = lerp(mouse.y, mouse.ty, 0.045);
    wind = lerp(wind, windT, 0.03);
    windT = lerp(windT, 0, 0.008);

    drawBackground(t, mouse.x, mouse.y);

    // Steam behind the chopsticks reads as depth — draw a faint back layer first
    // (front steam is drawn after the bowl below)
    const geom = drawBowl(t, mouse.x, mouse.y);
    drawSteam(t, dt, geom);

    // Update ripples
    for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      ripples[i].age += dt;
      if (ripples[i].age >= ripples[i].life) ripples.splice(i, 1);
    }

    drawVignetteAndGrain(t);
    return geom;
  }

  function drawStatic() {
    if (!W) return;
    mouse.x = 0; mouse.y = 0;
    drawBackground(0, 0, 0);
    const geom = drawBowl(0, 0, 0);
    drawStaticSteam(geom);
    drawVignetteAndGrain(0);
  }

  // ---------- loop ----------
  let rafId = null, lastTs = 0;
  function loop(ts) {
    const t = ts / 1000;
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, lastTs ? t - lastTs : 0.016);
    lastTs = t;
    // Motes drift
    for (const m of motes) {
      m.x += m.vx * dt * 10; m.y += m.vy * dt * 10;
      if (m.y < -0.02) { m.y = 1.02; m.x = Math.random(); }
      if (m.x < -0.02) m.x = 1.02; if (m.x > 1.02) m.x = -0.02;
    }
    draw(t, dt);
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  // ---------- interaction ----------
  function bowlGeomNow() {
    const bw = S * 0.62;
    return { rimRX: bw / 2, rimRY: bw * 0.185, rimY: cy + S * 0.015 };
  }
  function spawnRipple(clientX, clientY, strength) {
    const g = bowlGeomNow();
    const dx = (clientX - cx) / g.rimRX, dy = (clientY - g.rimY) / g.rimRY;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > 1.05) return;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - lastRippleAt < 70) return;
    lastRippleAt = now;
    ripples.push({ x: clientX, y: clientY, r: S * 0.018 * strength, age: 0, life: rand(0.9, 1.4) });
    if (ripples.length > 14) ripples.shift();
  }

  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    mouse.tx = (e.clientX / W - 0.5) * 2;
    mouse.ty = (e.clientY / H - 0.5) * 2;
    const vx = e.clientX - mouse.px;
    windT = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, vx * 0.012));
    mouse.px = e.clientX; mouse.py = e.clientY;
    if (!REDUCED && e.pointerType !== 'touch') spawnRipple(e.clientX, e.clientY, 0.8);
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (REDUCED) return;
    spawnRipple(e.clientX, e.clientY, 1.7);
    // A gentle extra breath of steam on tap
    for (const p of steam) if (Math.random() > 0.6) p.y = Math.min(1, p.y + 0.08);
  });

  window.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { mouse.tx = 0; mouse.ty = 0; });
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { mouse.tx = 0; mouse.ty = 0; });

  // Pause when the tab is hidden — no wasted frames
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (REDUCED) return;
    if (document.hidden) { if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId); rafId = null; lastTs = 0; }
    else if (!rafId) rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  });

  // React if the OS motion preference flips mid-session
  const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  if (typeof mq.addEventListener === 'function') {
    mq.addEventListener('change', (e) => { if (e.matches) location.reload(); });
  }

  // ---------- boot ----------
  initParticles();
